channel.title: Wandering Aerun
channel.description: Coming to you live on channel 43 from an undisclosed relay in the Sea of Silt. Everything you are about to hear is what a well-traveled Aerunite believes to be true. Which is not the same as true. An in-universe podcast for the Aerun campaign.
channel.itunes:author: The Wanderer

item.title: The White Hours
item.description: Why does the whole continent stop at noon? The Wanderer asks Master Yaxa of the School of Reckoning what the smart money does while everything's stopped — and gets audited on the air for his trouble. This episode brought to you by Stillwater, Kenaz, the Navigation Academy, and the Caravan Guild.

item.title: The Long Reach
item.description: The Wanderer opens channel forty-three with the silt report, talks tea and travelers with Bellin, keeper of Midreach waystation, runs the mail, and reminds you to stop for nothing that hails you from the gray. This episode brought to you by the School of Reckoning, the Menders' Hall, the city of Tyr, and the Open Market of Tyr.
